name: sentryfi
description: Sentryfi — Snap it. Record it. Done.

scripts.dev: npm run dev -w backend & npm run dev -w frontend
scripts.build: npm run render && npm run build -w frontend
scripts.start: npm run migrate && npm run ledger:gate && node backend/src/server.js
scripts.render: node tools/render-artboard.js design/project/App.dc.html frontend/public/design/phone.html && node tools/render-desktop.js frontend/public/design/desktop.html
scripts.ledger:gate: sh -c 'if [ "$LEDGER_SELFTEST" = "1" ]; then node backend/scripts/ledger-selftest.js || true; fi'
